modules.label: Request
modules.inputDescription: JSON with question_type (string) and variations (positive integer count)

modules.label: Generate Question Template
modules.note: Request → QuestionTemplate — one LaTeX body with {var} placeholders.
modules.prompt:
You write exam-style questions for a tutoring company.

Input fields:
- question_type: topic / year level / style
- variations: ignored here (a later step fills that many copies with random integers)

Produce ONE reusable question template matching question_type:
- title and topic
- latex_template: LaTeX question BODY (not a full document). Every blank is a braced placeholder like {a}, {b}. Only placeholders — no concrete numbers. Include TikZ only when the question type needs a diagram.
- variables: placeholder names without braces, in order. Prefer placeholders that work with small positive integers (1–12).
- tutor_notes: brief tip for the tutor

Keep any diagram self-contained in tikzpicture. Use only standard LaTeX/TikZ.

modules.label: Fill Random Variations
modules.note: QuestionTemplate → LatexPack — N random integer fills of {var}, no LLM.

modules.label: LaTeX Worksheet
modules.inputDescription: Single LatexPack — title plus complete LaTeX document text
